• FOUR BEDROOM SEMI-DETACHED HOME
  • PROMINENT CORNER SITE POSITION
  • COMTEMPORARY FINISHES THROUGHOUT
  • PRIVATE ENCLOSED REAR GARDEN
  • SPACIOUS LIVING ROOM WITH FEATURE FIREPLACE
  • OPEN PLAN KITCHEN / DINING AREA

Homepage Estate Agents are delighted to offer for sale this beautifully presented four bedroom semi detached family home situated within the popular Shearwater Way development in Londonderry.

Occupying a prominent corner site, 25 Shearwater Way offers spacious and contemporary accommodation throughout and has been exceptionally well maintained by its current owners. The welcoming entrance foyer leads to a bright and spacious living room complete with feature fireplace and large bay window overlooking the front aspect.

To the rear, the open plan kitchen and dining area provides an excellent everyday living and entertaining space with direct access to the rear hall, storage area and downstairs W.C. The property further benefits from contemporary finishes throughout, creating a modern and stylish feel across both floors.

Upstairs there are four well proportioned bedrooms together with a modern family bathroom and additional built-in storage. Sliderobes are fitted to all bedrooms as well as the landing, providing excellent practical storage solutions throughout the home.

Externally the property enjoys a private enclosed rear garden together with low maintenance outdoor areas. This superb home is sure to appeal to a wide range of buyers.

description:
Features 

  • Detached Four-Bedroom Family Home
  • Three Reception Rooms
  • Two Bathrooms
  • Integral Garage
  • Large Plot in a Desirable Cul-de-Sac
  • Chain Free
  • Vacant Possession
  • Off-Street Parking for Three to Four Vehicles
  • Early Viewing Strongly Recommended

Looking for more space? A home you can truly make your own? Your forever home?
If so, 5 Keery Park could be exactly what you have been waiting for.

James Gorman Property is delighted to bring to the sales market this well-maintained four-bedroom detached family home. Occupied and lovingly cared for by the same family for the past 31 years, the property sits on a generous plot with front, side, and rear gardens, along with ample off-street parking.

Offering excellent accommodation throughout, the home includes three reception rooms, a kitchen-diner, and a separate utility room. While some modernisation would be beneficial, this gives the new owners a great opportunity to put their own stamp on the property and create a superb long-term family home. Early internal inspection is highly recommended.

On entering the property, you are welcomed by a bright and spacious hallway with rooms to both the left and right. To the right is a generous front reception room featuring a central fireplace (gas). Across the hall, through double doors, is the dining room, an equally spacious room that could also serve as an ideal playroom or second family room.

At the end of the hallway is the kitchen-diner, the heart of the home, with comfortable dining space for four. Adjacent to the kitchen is the third reception room, offering excellent potential to create an open-plan kitchen, dining, and living area, subject to any necessary approvals. Off the kitchen, via a compact hallway, is the utility room, which provides direct access to the integral garage as well as the rear garden. A convenient ground floor WC is also accessed from the main hallway.

The first floor comprises four well-proportioned bedrooms and the family bathroom, which includes a separate shower cubicle. The master bedroom benefits from its own en-suite and a separate walk-in wardrobe room. Bedrooms two and three are both comfortable doubles and include built-in wardrobes. Bedroom four overlooks the front of the property and is also a well-proportioned double room.

The current owners have created a useful home office area on the landing, complete with a large built-in desk. There is also excellent storage on this floor, including a substantial hot press and an additional storage cupboard. Loft access is available from the landing.

Externally, the mature gardens are a real feature of the home. With lawns to the front, side, and rear, along with a decking area accessed via double doors from the third reception room, the outside space is ideal for family living and entertaining. There is ample parking to the front and side of the property.

This property is offered for sale chain free and with vacant possession.

For further information or to arrange a viewing, please contact James on 028 7161 0402.
Be sure to follow our social media channels for the latest property updates.

description:
Croc Na Rua’

Beautifully presented detached family home offering spacious and versatile accommodation finished to a high standard throughout. The property boasts a stunning open plan kitchen/living area with granite worktops, feature ‘Flavel’ range cooker and adjoining south facing sun room, ideal for modern family living and entertaining.

Internally, the home offers four generous bedrooms, including master bedroom with walk-in wardrobe and en suite, together with four bathrooms and a range of quality features including solid oak internal doors, feature oak staircase, decorative coving and pressurised water system.

Externally, the property is approached by ornate wrought iron gates leading to a large tarmac driveway with ample parking. Mature gardens surround the home with paved patio area to the rear, while the excellent detached double garage and versatile loft space provide additional storage, office or recreational potential.

A superb family home in an attractive setting, early viewing is highly recommended.

 

Features

uPVC double glazed windows

Oil fired heating

Solid oak internal doors

Solid oak feature staircase

Pressurised water system

Bison slab floors to 1st floor

Decorative coving to ceilings

Excellent location, easy access to the new A6 road network

 

Accommodation

Porch

uPVC front door and sidelight. Tiled floor.

Entrance Hall

French doors leading from porch into a spacious entrance hall. Tiled floor. Coving to ceiling.

Living Room    21’5 x 11’10

Feature open fire with marble fireplace and marble hearth. Coving to ceiling. Semi solid oak floor, TV points.

Kitchen/Living Area     24’10 x 14’5

Excellent range of eye and low level fitted kitchen units in a solid oak finish, incorporating a ‘Flavel’ 1200mm range with 7 ring gas hob and electric double oven, granite work tops, granite upstand, 1 ½ bowl stainless steel sink with mixer taps, ‘Bosch’ integrated dishwasher, integrated fridge freezer, centre island with seating configuration, tiled floor, down lighters, horizontal blinds.

Dining Room   13’5 x 11’9

French doors leading from kitchen/living area to dining room, coving to veiling, cushion flooring.

Sun Room        12’9 x 10’9

French doors leading from kitchen/living area into spacious south facing sun room with vaulted ceiling, double patio doors lead to patio and garden area.

Utility Room    7’8 x 6’3

Range of eye and low level fitted kitchen units with a ‘Belfast’ style sink with antique mixer taps. Walls part tiled, floor tiled, uPVC back door, horizontal blinds.

Ground Floor WC         7’8 x 3’4

Low flush wc, pedestal wash hand basin, heated towel rail, tiled floor, roller blind.

First Floor

Carpet to stairs and landing, shelved hot press.

Master Bedroom          16’9 x 11’8

Coving to ceiling. Carpet. Walk-in wardrobe.

En Suite            8’7 x 6’5

Low flush wc, large walk-in shower enclosure with mains power shower. Wash hand basin with vanity unit and mirrored bathroom unit. Cushion flooring, down lighters.

Bedroom 2       10’6 x 9’10

Laminate wooden floor. Coving to ceiling. TV points.

En Suite            6’9 x 3’3

Low flush wc, wash hand basin with vanity unit, mirrored bathroom unit and roller blind.

Bedroom 3       14’5 x 11’7

Range of mirrored slide robes, laminate wooden floor. TV points.

Bedroom 4       13’6 x 11’1       

Range of fitted bedroom furniture, carpet.

Main Bathroom             9’9 x 9’9

Suite includes low flush wc, mains power shower with glazed shower enclosure, ‘jacuzzi’ bath with mixer taps, ‘His and Hers’ wash hand basins with fitted vanity unit and mirrored bathroom unit, down lighters, walls fully tiled, floor tiled.

Detached Garage         21’5 x 21’8

Excellent large double garage with 2x sets of roller shutter doors, one of which is electric, pedestrian uPVC door.

Loft      21’2 x 13’3

Stars leading to loft which can be used for multiple purposes, such as kids play room, office or storage. Power points, lighting and radiators on both ground and first floor. External power points.

Exterior

Large spacious garden area which wraps around the property with mature trees, Laurel hedging, garden walls and ornate railings. Double wrought iron ornate gates on stone entrance pillars lead to a large tarmac driveway which provides off road parking for multiple vehicles. Paved patio area to the rear which is south facing.

description:
Show Home Open Viewing

By appointment only

Register now for future releases at Braidwater's award winning development, Beech Hill View.

The process to register and reserve your home prior to release to the general public could not be simpler. Simply go to braidwater.com and click on register your interest and follow the simple step by step guide.

Should you have any queries in the meantime please contact the CPS team on 028 71343600.

Become part of the Braidwater community!

Beech Hill View is a fantastic development of quality Braidwater Homes which are stylistic and designed with energy efficiency in mind.

FOR FURTHER INFORMATION PLEASE CONTACT OUR OFFICE ON 71343600

Located off the Glenshane Road, Beech Hill View combines the best aspects of modern living with the type of idyllic rural sanctuary that busy lifestyles crave. It’s a new development which also appeals to the traditional; a rustic setting that’s just 10 minutes from the city centre; uniquely designed homes that encourage a sense of belonging and community. It’s a rare opportunity to live life well in every respect.

You’ll find well-considered design everywhere at Beech Hill View. From the spacious front facing ‘Paddock’ that gives the development its community village feel, to the clever use of space in every kitchen, no aspect of modern life has been overlooked. Secluded gardens offer peaceful sanctuary, a wide boulevard places traffic further from pedestrians and front gardens, and a well-lit jogging and walking trail offers well-being on your doorstep.

Beech Hill View is situated in a peaceful suburb with unspoiled countryside views. But it is also exceptionally well-connected to important routes and destinations, with the soon to be new A6 roundabout on the doorstep - Belfast will be less than 90 minutes away.

A taste of countryside living with city charm.
